g.title: Text or scanned. heal() in converter.py is the entry point, and the pdf2docx-heal command in cli.py calls it with flags for OCR and for switching each repair off.

Runs only with --ocr. A page with under 50 characters of text counts as scanned, and when more than 30 percent of pages are scanned each one is rendered at 300 DPI and OCR'd by PyMuPDF's Tesseract call into a temp PDF. A page whose OCR fails is copied unchanged.
Replaces pdf2docx.common.share.is_list_item, which never matches upstream, and wraps Blocks.collect_stream_lines to force list_not_table=True. Applied once per process, only when list repair is on.
The upstream converter, unmodified apart from the two patches. It writes the first-pass .docx to disk.
Each pass opens the file with python-docx, edits it and saves it in place, inside its own try block, so one failing pass never costs the fixes from the others.

Splits merged paragraphs on bullet and number prefixes, reads nesting from the left indent and applies the built-in List Bullet and List Number styles. Lettered and roman lists get a generated OOXML numbering definition, and a sequence-reset check keeps titles like 4. Results as normal paragraphs.
Finds http, https, ftp, www and mailto text in body paragraphs and replaces it with w:hyperlink elements backed by external relationships, with blue underlined runs.
Looks the font name up in a fallback table, then falls back by Unicode range for CJK, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari and Cyrillic text, then to Arial.
